message: Hi Alex, it's Tom at Pulse Fitness, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Tom, thanks for the honest question. I can't promise a specific number of customers — no one honestly can, since that depends on your market, offers, and timing too. What I can promise is fixing the concrete issues hurting your site (speed, broken flows, mobile, etc.) for $900, using AI-assisted audits I review myself. Happy to send what I found first, no obligation.
